dialogueNodes.text: Hey! Are you here for the coding bootcamp too? The labs are just down the hallway.
I really need to finish my Python project before the deadline...
Have you seen the leaderboard? Some people are already level 10!
Coding is tough, but it's so satisfying when the code finally runs.
I'm stuck on a bug in my C++ assignment. It's driving me crazy!
Did you know the school guard loves coffee? I should get him some one day.
